titre: [$175] [Sentry: APP-MDA] Android HybridApp log sync crashes with NullPointerException in LinkedList.unlink
corps:
## Sentry https://expensify.sentry.io/issues/APP-MDA APP-MDA groups several different Java exceptions under a shared native abort frame. This issue tracks only the log-sync NullPointerException below. ## Impact (snapshot at filing) - Source: [APP-MDA crash classification](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/102742#issuecomment-7004558657), reviewing 611 events from 2026-08-26 through 2026-11-18. Counts below are from that review, not a fresh Sentry query. - Users (total since first seen): not available for this branch - Events: 32 (5.2% of the reviewed APP-MDA events) - Events on 9.5.34-1 or later: 7 - Users (last 14d): not available for this branch - First seen / last seen: not available separately for this branch; reported still happening in the review - Platform: Android HybridApp - App version(s): includes 9.5.34-1 or later; complete affected-version list not available - Affected flow: completion of a log-packet upload; no specific user route identified - Mechanism: SIGABRT, fatal ## Stack trace (top frames, first-party only) The source review identifies this underlying exception and Java collection frame; a complete representative event stack has not been attached: ```text NullPointerException java.util.LinkedList.unlink ``` ## Suspected cause The exception occurs during list removal when log-packet sending completes. Concurrent modification or invalid list state are hypotheses from the source discussion, not confirmed root causes. Attach representative events and establish the callback/list lifecycle before selecting a fix. This appears to be a backend/internal issue. A separate internal investigation is needed. ## Reproduction Unknown. Investigate log-upload completion, including overlapping callbacks and retry/teardown timing. These are investigation directions, not verified reproduction steps. Expected: log sync completes or handles an upload failure without crashing the app. ## Related - Parent tracker: [Top Sentry crashes monthly check-in](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/91302) - Source: [APP-MDA crash classification](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/102742#issuecomment-7004558657) - Separate original issue: [FragmentManager race in legacy OldDot navigation](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/102742). Its reported fix does not cover this exception. - Sibling Sentry IDs: none identified; this is a distinct exception within APP-MDA, not a new Sentry ID.
